title: Standards and relationship check — web operator guide
subject: Discharge-summary historical review pilot and other explicitly identified PPG versions
notice: Historical V6 and the retained template candidate are development inputs. Current-source verification stays open and nonblocking. This check does not establish clinical authority or compliance.

sections.title: 1. Choose the document and inspected version
steps: Use the stable Document UID from the catalogue; a title alone does not identify a document.
Enter the exact inspected version label recorded for this review. A catalogue assertion is not verified current document content.
Keep different inspection, document and framework editions separate; do not overwrite old labels to make a match.

links.label: Return to the historical review pilot

sections.hold: Unknown document identity or blank version refuses context. Current procedure/template authority remains unverified.

sections.title: 2. Run the check in the web
steps: Open the existing standards check flow and select Run. Enter Document UID and Document version, then select Run flow once.
Use the existing qualified connections. Do not add a new connection, consent, licence or permission to clear an error.
The launch acknowledgement only confirms submission. Open that exact run in its run history; do not substitute another successful run.

links.label: Run the on-demand standards and relationship check

sections.hold: There is no schedule, policy-owner notification action or automatic clinical decision. Per-flow failure alerts are off; global digest settings are separate.

sections.title: 3. Inspect the final report and relevant records
steps: Require the run to succeed and the final Report_context action to succeed after Source_snapshot_stable.
Inspect registerCounts, selected document/version, directProposed versus directAccepted and exact-version upstream/downstream links.
Other-version mappings remain separate. Proposed or unresolved records are review leads; draft frameworks are not current obligations.
Use the register views to inspect evidence and separately recorded human decision references. A reference presence check does not authenticate authority.
sections.hold: Parsed_context and script output alone are not a final report. This current-row check does not validate full native history or enforce direct SharePoint saves.

sections.title: 4. Resolve a refusal without changing clinical state
sections.trigger: A check fails or a report is skipped
steps: For an unknown identity or version, reconcile the exact catalogue identity and inspected version before a new run.
For StandardsSourceChanged, preserve the run reference and inspect the changed records. Run a fresh check after reconciliation.
Do not accept or modify a policy, mapping or relationship merely to clear a technical failure. Preserve old evidence, drafts and history.
The qualified mismatch test changed only a temporary read query, never a catalogue row. Its normal definition was restored. Timed concurrent-edit testing is not claimed.
sections.hold: A failed or skipped final report must not be used as a successful check, even if intermediate script output exists.

sections.title: 5. Retain evidence and recover
sections.trigger: Use a report in review preparation or investigate a failure
steps: Retain the exact run link, inspected document/version, source context and script/contract versions with the review evidence. Native run history has finite retention.
Use the existing evidence library and supported manual versioned-record process; preserve earlier evidence rather than overwriting it.
The recovery companion preserves qualified inputs, reports, definition/bindings and code. Its isolated verifier makes no native writes.
Restore into a separate target only after checking current connections, source/script bindings, access and alert preferences. Do not replay archived mutation scripts or old run identifiers.

links.label: Open the standards web-check recovery companion

sections.hold: Native copied restore and broader ordinary-user adoption remain unverified. Real clinical decisions, AI and current-edition authority are separate.
